reviews.author: Atzyri Lopez
reviews.text: Says the space feels welcoming, with staff who treat every visit like family and offer genuine styling advice.

reviews.author: Amanda Merlino
reviews.text: Describes the owners and team as personable and kind, and hadn't found a vintage shop like it in years.

reviews.author: Santiago Garibay
reviews.text: Praises the varied, unique selection of vintage clothing and oddities, plus friendly help.

reviews.author: Michael G.
reviews.text: Calls out the matcha and cold brew as standouts, and likes that it's locally run.

reviews.author: Grace S.
reviews.text: Says the small iced Americano was excellent and the service was fast and friendly.

reviews.author: Martha G.
reviews.text: Recommends the simple, well-done menu of bacon or sausage, egg, and cheese sandwiches.
